request.project_task: Build an online symptom triage and appointment routing service.
request.project_goal: Route non-emergency requests while identifying cases needing urgent help.
request.project_description: A patient answers questions; the service gives a routing recommendation and schedules eligible requests.

functional_requirements.text: A patient selects a symptom category.

atoms.text: A patient selects a symptom category.

functional_requirements.text: The system displays an emergency warning when configured red flags are present.

atoms.text: The system displays an emergency warning when configured red flags are present.

functional_requirements.text: The system recommends a care route for non-emergency answers.

atoms.text: The system recommends a care route for non-emergency answers.

functional_requirements.text: The patient books an offered appointment.

atoms.text: The patient books an offered appointment.

functional_requirements.text: A clinician reviews submitted answers before the appointment.

atoms.text: A clinician reviews submitted answers before the appointment.

functional_requirements.text: The patient can correct answers before clinician review.

atoms.text: The patient can correct answers before clinician review.

non_functional_requirements.text: The service must state that its output is not a diagnosis.
The requirements do not provide the red-flag rule set.
Sensitive answers must be accessible only to the patient and assigned clinician.

actors.name: Patient
actors.description: A person seeking non-emergency symptom triage and appointment routing.

actors.name: Clinician
actors.description: A healthcare professional who reviews submitted answers before an appointment.

use_cases.name: Complete symptom triage and receive routing recommendation
use_cases.goal: The patient answers symptom questions and receives a care routing recommendation, including an emergency warning when red flags are present.
use_cases.trigger: Patient starts a symptom triage session.

preconditions.text: The patient has access to the Triage Route service.

success_postconditions.text: The patient has received a care route recommendation or an emergency warning.

failure_postconditions.text: The patient does not receive a routing recommendation due to an error or interruption.

steps.expected_result: The system accepts the selected symptom category.

steps.action: The system evaluates the answers for configured red flags.
The system recommends a care route for non-emergency answers.
steps.expected_result: The patient receives a care route recommendation.

alternative_scenarios.name: Emergency warning due to red flags

steps.expected_result: The system accepts the selected symptom category.

steps.action: The system evaluates the answers for configured red flags.
The system displays an emergency warning.
steps.expected_result: The patient sees an emergency warning.

user_stories.capability: select a symptom category and answer category-specific questions
user_stories.benefit: I can describe my symptoms and get appropriate routing.

user_stories.capability: receive an emergency warning when red flags are present
user_stories.benefit: I know when to seek urgent help.

user_stories.capability: receive a care route recommendation for non-emergency answers
user_stories.benefit: I know where to go for care.

system_stories.system_action: Evaluate answers against configured red flags.
system_stories.responsibility: Detect emergency indicators and trigger an emergency warning.

system_stories.system_action: Generate a care route recommendation for non-emergency answers.
system_stories.responsibility: Provide routing guidance based on the patient's answers.

missing_information.description: The red-flag rule set is not provided in the requirements.

unsupported_assumptions.description: The system can evaluate answers against configured red flags without the rule set being specified.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Complete symptom triage and receive routing recommendation
Goal: The patient answers symptom questions and receives a care routing recommendation, including an emergency warning when red flags are present.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Patient starts a symptom triage session.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: The patient has access to the Triage Route service.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Selects a symptom category.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] Answers category-specific questions.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] The system evaluates the answers for configured red flags.
  4. [STEP-UC001-004] The system recommends a care route for non-emergency answers.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-ALT-001: Emergency warning due to red flags
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-004

use_cases.name: Book an offered appointment
use_cases.goal: The patient books an appointment offered as part of the care route recommendation.
use_cases.trigger: The patient receives a care route recommendation that includes an offered appointment.

preconditions.text: The patient has completed triage and received a non-emergency care route recommendation.

success_postconditions.text: The patient has booked an offered appointment.

failure_postconditions.text: The appointment is not booked due to an error or unavailability.

steps.expected_result: The system accepts the appointment selection.

steps.action: The system confirms the appointment booking.
steps.expected_result: The patient receives a booking confirmation.

user_stories.benefit: I can secure a time to see a clinician.

system_stories.responsibility: Confirm and record the booked appointment.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Book an offered appointment
Goal: The patient books an appointment offered as part of the care route recommendation.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: The patient receives a care route recommendation that includes an offered appointment.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: The patient has completed triage and received a non-emergency care route recommendation.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Selects an offered appointment.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] The system confirms the appointment booking.
Source FRs: FR-005

use_cases.name: Review submitted answers before appointment
use_cases.goal: The clinician reviews the patient's submitted answers before the appointment.
use_cases.trigger: An appointment is booked and the patient's answers are available for review.

preconditions.text: The patient has submitted answers and booked an appointment.

success_postconditions.text: The clinician has reviewed the submitted answers.

failure_postconditions.text: The clinician cannot review the answers due to access or availability issues.

steps.expected_result: The system displays the submitted answers to the clinician.
The clinician has reviewed the answers before the appointment.

user_stories.capability: review submitted answers before the appointment
user_stories.benefit: I can prepare for the appointment with the patient's information.

system_stories.system_action: Provide the submitted answers to the assigned clinician.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure the clinician can access the answers before the appointment.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Review submitted answers before appointment
Goal: The clinician reviews the patient's submitted answers before the appointment.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: An appointment is booked and the patient's answers are available for review.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: The patient has submitted answers and booked an appointment.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] Accesses the patient's submitted answers.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] Reviews the submitted answers.
Source FRs: FR-006

use_cases.name: Correct answers before clinician review
use_cases.goal: The patient corrects previously submitted answers before the clinician reviews them.
use_cases.trigger: The patient identifies an error in their submitted answers before clinician review.

preconditions.text: The patient has submitted answers and the clinician has not yet reviewed them.

success_postconditions.text: The patient's corrected answers are saved and available for clinician review.

failure_postconditions.text: The corrections are not saved due to an error or because clinician review has already occurred.

main_success_scenario.name: Patient corrects answers before clinician review

steps.action: Selects to correct previously submitted answers.
steps.expected_result: The system allows the patient to edit the answers.
The system saves the corrected answers.

user_stories.benefit: I can ensure my information is accurate before the clinician sees it.

system_stories.system_action: Allow the patient to edit and resubmit answers before clinician review.
system_stories.responsibility: Update the stored answers with the patient's corrections.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-004 — Correct answers before clinician review
Goal: The patient corrects previously submitted answers before the clinician reviews them.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: The patient identifies an error in their submitted answers before clinician review.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC004-001: The patient has submitted answers and the clinician has not yet reviewed them.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC004-001] Selects to correct previously submitted answers.
  2. [STEP-UC004-002] Submits corrected answers.
Source FRs: FR-007

  ADN-UC001-007 --> ADN-UC001-008
